summary: Full backend + frontend verification of GlowLeads. 27/27 backend tests pass (auth, public funnel, AI detect+try-on, leads/bookings, tech dashboard CRUD, agency dashboard, RBAC). Frontend: Landing, Customer funnel up to Step 4 (style grid with 7 category tabs), Tech login + 4 tabs (Home/Appts/Leads/Settings) all rendering data, Agency login + 5 sidebar pages (Overview/Clients/Analytics/Style Intel/Billing) all populated. AI try-on backend verified to gracefully fallback (HTTP 200 with style stock image when AI unavailable).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1000 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, public, ai, tech, agency, seed) for maintainability

AI fallbacks: try-on returns the static stock style image when Gemini fails; clearly tagged source='fallback' so frontend can warn users if desired (currently UI does not differentiate). Acceptable for MVP.
TechDashboard.jsx: API calls fire on tab mount with no loading state — quick tab switches show empty state '0 cards' briefly before data arrives. Consider a skeleton/loader.
Agency analytics: leads_weekly bucket loop runs N×5 count_documents queries (one per tech per week). Fine for 3 techs but won't scale; should be one aggregate pipeline.

agency_overview at_risk threshold: techs with 0 leads (e.g. Bella) correctly flagged — but the seed only inserts leads for Sophie, so on a fresh DB Bella & Jade always show as 'at risk'. Document or seed minimal leads for them.
JWT_EXPIRY_HOURS = 24 * 30 = 30 days; for production tokens should be shorter with refresh tokens.
register endpoint: business_name slug collision handled, but no unique-slug retry cap besides loop — fine for now.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on flows tested (Landing, funnel start, Tech 4 tabs with data, Agency 5 pages with data)

test_credentials: Tech: sophie@glowleads.com / sophie123 (slug=sophie). Agency: harry@glowleads.com / agency123. Other techs: bella/bella123, jade/jade123. Source: /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed lead + booking under Sophie (intentionally left for activity feed verification). One appointment was marked 'completed' via update test (idempotent). Created 1 random TEST_xxxx@example.com tech via /api/auth/register.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_glowleads.py covers all 27 critical paths. UI confirmed working: Landing, /try/sophie funnel through Step 4 (style grid, 7 categories), Tech dashboard (8 appt cards, 11 lead cards, 60 style toggles in Settings/Styles tab, Page panel save form), Agency (4 KPIs, 4 client rows, Analytics/Style Intel/Billing all rendered, 4 subscription rows). Funnel Step 5 → Step 7 (preview→booking→confirm) NOT exercised end-to-end via Playwright due to AI try-on latency (60-90s); backend AI try-on is verified to return 200 with a preview URL (fallback mode acceptable). Use waits >=8s when navigating between tech-dashboard tabs because each tab fires its own API call on mount and locator counts are 0 until the response returns.
rca of the issue: No bugs needing RCA. Initial Playwright runs showed false-positive 0-count failures because we asserted card counts immediately after tab-content selectors became visible, before the per-tab fetch completed. Adding wait_for_selector on the card testid resolved it; this is a test-side issue only, not a product bug.
